trial_title: Laparoscopic Versus Open Devascularization for Portal Hypertension, a Randomized Controlled Trial
brief_summary: Many patients with portal hypertension require surgical treatment each year,and Hassab's operation, or esophagogastric devascularization and splenectomy, is an elective procedure. In recent years,laparoscopic esophagogastric devascularization and splenectomy has been used to treat portal hypertension.
